reason: Indoor options for little kids around Salisbury are thin, and $12 a drop-in is nothing on our income. I'd try it on a Saturday or two, but I'd stay on drop-in rather than commit to a membership.
objection: I only have weekends, so a monthly membership only pays off if I go 5+ times a month, and I don't trust a fancy 'Montessori-inspired' cafe to still be good and not just Instagram once the novelty fades.
would_change_my_mind: A membership that works for weekend-only use (or a visit-pack/weekend-only tier around $30-35), plus proof it is actually clean, calm and well run, e.g. a trial visit or reviews from local parents.
